_about: The fixed evaluation set of sandbox/eval/run.mjs. Each task is one comment on a new copy of one document. `expect` is what a good assistant does: edit (an edit and a resolved reply), ask (one short question, no edit, thread open) or decline (no edit, a reply that says why, thread open). judge.md has the rubric.
